2438-7084-8347.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5702-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
5702-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, either creating a 1/1 green Insect creature token or causing you to pay {1}{G} and create a copy of the creature enchanted by Springheart Nantuko
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-643-6974.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Ashling's Command
147-643-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ashling's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-643-6974.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

728-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4875-5310-6879-8095.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5310-6879-8095.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1170-2921-4908-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-4908-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

4153-4802-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

801-5220-6798-7855.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

864-1312-2034-4871-7297.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-7297.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

719-2511-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-2511-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1818-5010-5256-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

5051-5078-5268-6766.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

864-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
864-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake
When Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
864-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

182-1068-6907.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters, it triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Cosmogoyf, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Cosmogoyf's power.
182-1068-6907.notes: It is recommended to do this combo when it will end the game. As you have an empty library, drawing a card will cause you to lose the game.

500-1777-2493.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Archaeomancer and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Archaeomancer token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

252-2073-6798--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

104-3197-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-6719.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-2661-3692.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

4651-6714.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block the creature that has Super State and Phyresis attached.
The creature with Super State and Phyresis attached has power 10 or greater, or each opponent has at least one poison counter
4651-6714.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Super State and Phyresis attached, causing the opponent it was attacking to get at least ten poison counters. The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Super State triggers, causing the creature to cause each opponent to get at least ten poison counters. The opponents lose the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

465-1849-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1849-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

101-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
101-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2792-3489-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2792-3489-5241.description:
Declare Sakashima's Student as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking as a copy of any nonlegendary creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

539-862-1659-2232.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

167-4050-4863.description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Revolutionist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {B}.
When Revolutionist dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

678-2452-4349.description:
Cast Fell Stinger by paying {0}.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Fell Stinger dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

824-1887-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a counter on it.
824-1887-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a counter from a creature, and putting two of that type of counter on another target creature.
Repeat.

1263-2178-2438-2661.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Gwenna.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has attacked this turn.
1263-2178-2438-2661.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Gwenna, untapping Gwenna.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
